# Let me try moving RIGHT to approach the orange cells.

    r, c = player_pos
    # Player body extends from col c-2 to c+2 (YWwWY)

    print(f"\nRow {r}, cols {c+2} to {c+8}: '{ascii_lines[r][c+2:c+8]}'")
